articles.title: Claude Code Extension Could Let AI Agents Access Files Outside Trusted Workspaces Through Symlinks
articles.summary:

A researcher says this can lead users to approve file access outside their trusted workspace. Anthropic closed the report as informative and did not treat it as a vulnerability. The researcher disagrees and says the issue is unpatched […]

articles.title: Hackers Revive Retadup Botnet Shut Down in 2019 to Deliver CoffeeLoader Malware via USB Drive
articles.summary:

An updated variant detected in August 2026 combines removable-drive propagation with GPU-assisted unpacking, process injection, and cryptographically verified payload delivery.
